main_body: Treasure chest with a heap of gold coins and gems spilling over its front rim, plus a small loose gold pile at the lower right
top_band: At x=17: rows 2-6 hold the gold heap, with gems and a dark line at row 6. Rows 7-8 are a lighter gold band (L=138), which is the visible surface of the contents above the chest front.
evidence: The gold heap on top is read from above as a surface about 6 rows tall, with a lighter coin band over the chest front. The wooden front face below (rows 9-14, L=101) has a clear tone step of about 37 L from the gold, and it carries dark iron straps and an inset keyhole lock plate. No receding side face is drawn. The eave shadow is weak, but the heaped contents above a real front face read as 3/4, not as a front elevation with a thin cap.

style.evidence: The candidate has 27 colours per tile against 17 and 20 for the references, 0% flat-fill coverage, and 0% neutral dark edge pixels, so its outlines are tinted (dark brown beside wood). The gold has several steps (highlight, light, mid, shadow), the wood has plank grain and straps, and the gems add varied accents. It is at least as rich as the references and would not look thinner next to them.
